thread:
deploy-bot: Promotion stalled for release window '2024-05-10T15:00Z' — prefetch from mirror returned 504 (3 retries), canary smoke 3/5 failed. Holding promotion.

maria: yeah seeing the same in staging logs, wheel shard fetch errors and a bunch of 503s.

sam: mirror read retries look like they hit a rate limit on the storage side — responses include Retry-After and some 429s. Could be a thundering prefetch from the deploybot fleet.

maria: stack trace excerpt:
```
curl https://mirror.internal/repo/wheels/abc123 -I
HTTP/1.1 503 Service Unavailable
Retry-After: 10
```

john: do we have a last-good artifact we can pin to for the release window? current candidate (sha: abcdef1) passed canaries yesterday. New build sha: f1e2d3 failed prefetch.

sam: +1 pin to abcdef1 to unblock. We should also increase backoff on prefetch to avoid hammering mirror during next rollout.

maria: if we pin, we need a formal note in the release notes: 'pinned runtime image to abcdef1 due to mirror prefetch failures; will re-run full promotion after mirror backfill.'

sre-oncall: digging into mirror side — seeing a surge from 10.0.0.0/24 at 15:00Z matching deploybot fleet. I can temporarily throttle that CID on the mirror to smooth traffic if we want to rerun.

john: option A: pin and promote now. Option B: throttle mirror + let deploybot retry (risking time over change window). Which do we prefer?

sam: timeboxed decision: if we can't clear by 15:10Z, pin. Change window ends 15:30Z.

maria: agreed. Trying a manual rerun with increased prefetch backoff now (local patch to deploybot config).

sam: +1 on the patch but still prepare to pin. Running `deploybot promote --canary --retries=8 --backoff=2s` now.

(monitoring)

maria: rerun still hits 504s after 6m, mirror returns intermittent 502/503. Not recovering fast enough.

sam: ok pining.

sam: /deploybot pin image=sha:abcdef1 reason="mirror prefetch failures during release window" initiated by sam

deploy-bot: Image pinned to abcdef1 by sam. Promotion resumed for release window. Canary smoke now 5/5 passing.

maria: promoted. Updated release notes draft: 'Temporary pin to abcdef1 to avoid release disruption; follow-up: increase prefetch backoff and add mirror read-rate metrics.'

john: filing an incident doc and assigning to infra-team to investigate mirror scaling and rate-limits.

sre-oncall: I will add a short-term throttle and follow up with mirror provider.

maria: tl;dr — pinned to last-good image to unblock release, will roll forward after mirror fix. Logging action in #incidents and adding task to postmortem. :white_check_mark:
